name: project-triage
description: Classify a software project or component on nine validated axes — fault reproducibility, resource pressure, tail obligation, writer topology, data gravity, commitment reversibility, requirements volatility, oracle strength, defect consequence — and emit a committal, falsifiable record of which engineering concerns dominate it and which recede. Quick pass first, deep passes only where flagged; every answer names its evidence artifact and its re-fire trigger. Includes a grading mode that revisits old records against what actually happened.
